request.initial_prompt: Sebastian. Whiles we stood here securing your repose, Even now, we heard a hollow burst of bellowing Like bulls, or rather lions: did't not wake you? It struck mine ear most terribly.

raw_segments.text: Sebastian, Whiles we stood here securing your repose, Even now, we heard a hollow burst
of bellowing Like bulls, or rather lions, did not wake you?
It struck mine ear most terribly.
